name: substack.issue
description: Substack Growth OS: grade one draft Substack issue (rigoperator.substack.com, RIG B2B lane) before it reaches Mike. Judges angle originality, reader fit, evidence, the free/paid split, the single next step and generic-AI risk. Criteria come from ss-bestseller and substack-doctrine (914-transcript corpus). Advisory until calibrated against Mike's labels.

archetype.instructions: Given the title, subtitle and body of this newsletter issue, which archetype is it?

criteria.original_take: Names a specific mechanism, tension, failure or number from real work that the obvious version of this topic would miss
criteria.competent: Useful and correct, but the angle is the expected one for this topic
criteria.repeat: Restates generic advice already saturating the topic
criteria.rehash: Vague: the title does not say what the reader leaves with

reader_named.instructions: The issue is written for one identifiable reader (a role with a concrete problem, e.g. an owner or ops lead whose AI tools are not running anything) and every section serves that reader

evidence_grounded.instructions: Claims are backed by dated, specific receipts from real work (a build, a failure, a measured number, a named and permissioned client) rather than assertion or invented statistics

depth_split.instructions: The free part delivers real value on its own (the what and the why), and anything behind a paywall or offered as a paid perk is the how: implementation, templates or walkthroughs a reader would pay for. If there is no paywall, answer for whether the free part stands alone.

next_step_clear.instructions: The issue ends with exactly one clear next step for the reader (reply, subscribe, upgrade, download one asset, or book the review), not several competing asks and not none

generic_risk.instructions: This issue reads like generic AI-written content marketing that any competitor could publish unchanged (buzzwords, listicle padding, no lived detail)

rules.reason: the title does not name a payoff; rewrite the title and first lines before Mike sees it (threshold provisional, pending calibration)
saturated generic take; find the RIG-specific mechanism or failure first (collision engine / idea gates)
reads as generic AI content; run anti-slop and replace abstractions with receipts
claims are not traceable to receipts; every number needs a source (Mike's hard law)
no clear reader; tie the issue to the ss-strategy reader card
free part does not stand alone or the paid part is not the how; fix the split per ss-bestseller
no single next step; pick one (ss-convert)

notes.created: 2026-09-28 for ss-growth-os / ss-write / ss-gate; replaces post.viral as the issue grader. Calibrate with rig-s1gate label once Mike has approved or rejected 20+ issues.
